name: Plymouth County, MA
findings: Plymouth County has 1,597 nonprofit organizations. 525 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 427 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Plymouth County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Plymouth County list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 60% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 441 organizations here; 28% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
